answers.reason: The full professor operates within a single faculty, while the senate handles university-wide strategy and is chaired by the president.
Budget allocation across the university falls under the chancellor's responsibility, not the full professor's.
Every member participates in only one body, and the full professor's primary place for faculty affairs is the faculty council rather than a specialized committee.
As a chairholder in the faculty, the full professor's matters are decided in the faculty council, making it their designated place to take part.
Members only sit in one body, and the full professor belongs to the faculty council rather than the advisory study commission.
Examination matters are separate from the general faculty affairs where the full professor participates.
Since each member participates in only one body, the full professor sits in the faculty council rather than the internal grant round.
Rewriting module descriptions is a narrow working task separate from the faculty council where the full professor takes part.
Laboratory equipment procurement is treated as a separate technical question outside the full professor's single designated body.
Planning the orientation week for new students is unrelated to the full professor's role and designated body.
